Ooredoo تعلن عن تمديد استثنائي لآجال الم: Ooredoo announces an exceptional extension of the deadline for participation in the "Etoile Montante" competition
في إطار حرصها على إتاحة الفرصة أمام أكبر: As part of its commitment to giving the maximum number of students the opportunity to participate in the third edition of the "Etoile Montante" competition, Ooredoo announces an exceptional extension of the deadline for submitting application files until Thursday 20 August 2026, in response to requests received from students and following the approval of the jury.
تدعو Ooredoo الطلبة الجامعيين إلى تقديم: Ooredoo invites university students to submit their work on the theme "Artificial Intelligence and the Future of Media in Algeria: Challenges and Prospects", reflecting their visions on one of the most prominent issues shaping the future of media in light of rapid technological developments.
لتيسير إجراءات المشاركة، خصصت Ooredoo من: To facilitate participation procedures, Ooredoo has dedicated an online platform to receive application files via the link: https://ore.do/etoile-montante-participation. Files can also be sent via email: etoilemontante@ooredoo.dz
تُفتح المسابقة أمام المشاركات الفردية فق: The competition is open to individual entries only, with each candidate submitting a single work in one of the following languages: Arabic, Amazigh, French, or English.
للاطلاع على النظام الداخلي للمسابقة وشرو: To consult the internal regulations of the competition and the terms and conditions of participation, you can visit the Ooredoo website under the "About Ooredoo" section, then the "Etoile Montante" subsection.
تجسد مسابقة \"النجمة الصاعدة\" التزام Oo: The "Etoile Montante" competition embodies Ooredoo's ongoing commitment to supporting academic excellence and encouraging creativity and innovation, by providing a space that allows students to showcase their abilities, present their ideas, and contribute to keeping pace with digital transformations and shaping the media of the future.
